summary: Frontend-only verification (read-only DOM/href checks) of anti-duplication refinement in 'Empresa → Tendencias' mode. Tests covered: (1) MSFT (NOT covered) trend card on /thesis/thesis_test_company_msft: trend-dup-msg contains the required new copy and the trend-add button + generate-anyway link with matched=thesis_test_aidc&auto=1 are present; (2) NVDA (covered) on /thesis/thesis_test_company_nvda: trend-already-in shown, NO trend-add button, generate-anyway link still present with matched=thesis_test_aidc; (3) /thesis without id/cookie loads thesis-page without errors. The 'Generar de todas formas' link correctly appends both &auto=1 and &matched=${match.thesis_id} so the downstream generate flow can exclude the already-covered company.

seed_data_creation: Used pre-existing seed (thesis_test_company_msft, thesis_test_company_nvda, thesis_test_aidc). No re-seed needed.

Use prefix matchers like '[data-testid^=trend-dup-msg-inteligencia art]'. Backend generate with matched_thesis_id is already verified by E1 via curl; do NOT click 'Generar de todas formas' or 'Añadir' (expensive/mutating).
